$comment: GH-768 - THE AMMONIUM ACETATE SUFFICIENCY RANGES, ONE FILE, ONE READER.
Moved, not edited, from the literal `aaRanges` in mlsnEngine (assets/hub-tissue-v3.js, the
`methodology === "ammonium_acetate"` branch): both soil types, all ten nutrients. Read by the
server alone (App\Support\AaRanges), which judges an AA sample with them. There is no JavaScript
copy: the engine still holds its literal, and tests/gh768-the-aa-ranges-have-one-file.test.js
holds the two equal until the engine is moved onto the file, which is a separate decision.
bySoilType: `sands` and `others`, each nutrient with `lo` and `hi` in ppm (Olsen P in mg/L, which
is equivalent). Which one a site uses comes from its construction, resolved by the construction
The micronutrients are the same for both soil types in the engine, and are copied as they stand
rather than folded into one place: the file says what the engine says.
certificateOverridable: the five the Hill Labs certificate may override, as the engine's own list
does (`["P", "K", "Ca", "Mg", "S"].forEach`). A certificate carrying Fe would otherwise reach
the server and not the engine, and the two would part without anyone touching this file.
